description: This file defines options and configuration handling for Kubernetes API server authentication, including support for various authentication methods such as OIDC, token files, webhooks, and anonymous access. It includes structures for options, validation, and methods to apply configurations, as well as logic for dynamic reloading of authentication configs.

classes.name: BuiltInAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Contains all authentication options for Kubernetes API server, including OIDC, token files, webhooks, anonymous access, and service accounts.

classes.name: OIDCAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Options for configuring OIDC authentication, including issuer URL, client ID, claims, and signing algorithms.

classes.name: ServiceAccountAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Options for service account token authentication, including key files, issuers, and token expiration settings.

classes.name: TokenFileAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Options for token file authentication, specifying the token file path.

classes.name: WebHookAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Options for webhook-based authentication, including config file, version, cache TTL, and retry backoff.

methods.name: NewBuiltInAuthenticationOptions
methods.description: Creates a new instance of BuiltInAuthenticationOptions with default cache TTL values.

methods.name: WithAll
methods.description: Sets default values for all authentication options.

methods.name: WithAnonymous
methods.description: Enables anonymous authentication with default settings.

methods.name: WithOIDC
methods.description: Enables OIDC authentication with default claims and signing algorithms.

methods.name: WithServiceAccounts
methods.description: Enables service account authentication with default settings.

methods.name: WithWebHook
methods.description: Enables webhook authentication with default config.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the current authentication options for conflicts or misconfigurations.

methods.name: ToAuthenticationConfig
methods.description: Converts the options into a kubeauthenticator.Config object for use in the API server.

methods.name: ApplyTo
methods.description: Applies the authentication configuration to the API server context, including dynamic reloads.

methods.name: ApplyAuthorization
methods.description: Adjusts authentication options based on authorization mode settings.
